data.name: Create or Update Ticket Field Option
data.description:
Creates or updates an option for the given drop-down ticket field.
To update an option, include the id of the option in the custom_field_option object. Example:
{"custom_field_option": {"id": 10002, "name": "Pineapples", ... }
If an option exists for the given ID, the option will be updated. Otherwise, a new option will be created.
Response
Returns one of the following status codes:

200 with Location: /api/v2/ticket_fields/{ticket_field_id}/options.json if the ticket field option already
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a new option or updates an existing option for a drop-down ticket field. Use the option identifier to modify an existing value.
Use for: add a field option, rename an option, modify option details
Not supported: creating ticket fields, updating tickets, managing forms

data.name: Update Ticket Form
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing ticket form for administrators. Supply the form identifier and changed properties.
Use for: rename a form, change form settings, update form configuration
Not supported: creating forms, editing tickets, managing field options

data.name: Create Email for Support Ticket
data.description: Create a email with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard emails is provided.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an email record associated with support operations and returns the created object with its identifier.
Use for: log a support email, create an email record, capture escalation correspondence
Not supported: sending email, creating tickets, updating contacts

data.name: Update Ticket
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing Zendesk ticket using its identifier and supplied properties. Fields omitted from the payload remain unchanged.
Use for: change ticket status, update ticket priority, reassign a ticket
Not supported: creating tickets, deleting tickets, updating ticket forms

data.name: Create or update a batch of tickets by unique property values
data.description: Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the idProperty query param. idProperty query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates or updates multiple HubSpot ticket records using a unique property value for matching. The response reports the resulting records.
Use for: batch upsert tickets, synchronize ticket records, update tickets by external ID
Not supported: deleting tickets, querying tickets, managing ticket pipelines

data.name: Create
data.description: Create a ticket with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard tickets is provided.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a HubSpot ticket with supplied properties and returns the created object, including its identifier.
Use for: create a support ticket, log a customer issue, open a service case
Not supported: updating tickets, deleting tickets, searching existing tickets

data.name: Update Ticket
data.description:
Using the ticket key, update the ticket. There are a few key things to note. 
1. At least one key is required in the body to update the ticket 
2. Once assigned, you cannot unset the ownerId, ticketTeamId, or ticketGroupId 
3. If a parameter is not included in the body, the field will not be updated. 



This API call is only available to organizations that have purchased Closed Loop Follow Up. Organizations not enrolled will receive a 403 with the error code
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing Qualtrics ticket by ticket key. Include at least one editable field; omitted fields remain unchanged.
Use for: change ticket status, update ticket ownership, modify ticket assignment
Not supported: creating tickets, deleting tickets, retrieving ticket details
